source.title: The current state and open problems of the theory of semigroups of continuous mappings

trace.notes: Normalized the single URL source https://zbmath.org/3699820 as a zbMATH resolver record with source name 3699820.

Local source-index metadata identified zbMATH id 3699820 as the 1980 work titled "The current state and open problems of the theory of semigroups of continuous mappings". Exact-title web search corroborated K. D. Magill Jr.'s Russian Mathematical Surveys 35(3) entry, and MathNet issue metadata exposed a same-year candidate article titled "Recent results and open problems in semigroups of continuous self-maps" with DOI 10.1070/RM1980v035n03ABEH001698.

Input could not be normalized to a readable PDF or HTML full-text source. Failure mode: network_or_dns_failure for local shell fetches of zbmath.org and www.mathnet.ru, plus metadata_only/cache-miss recovery from zbMATH, MathNet issue pages, DOI/IOP candidates, exact-title search results, and related reference-list snippets. Bounded recovery attempts used the zbMATH id, exact title plus PDF, the candidate DOI, MathNet issue and full-text locators, and IOP DOI locators. No readable exact-work PDF or HTML body containing the problem statements was recovered, so no extraction was performed from metadata, abstracts, search snippets, or related works.
Saved exact JSON output to outputs/parse-paper/3699820.json and outputs/latest.json.
